englishTitle: Structural Forcing-Corridor and Decision-Funnel Study 1 — Prospective exact validation of sustained reply narrowing and branch-to-RAW convergence in bounded Bao local geometry
japaneseTitle: Baoにおけるstructural forcing corridorとdecision funnelのprospective exact検証 — sustained reply narrowingとbranch-to-RAW convergenceによるbounded局所経路構造の再現可能なphase差の検証

canonicalSerialization.integerRepresentation: decimal integer or decimal string as frozen by upstream family
canonicalSerialization.crossImplementationEquality: SHA-256 equality of canonical scientific JSON content; object prototype, insertion order, runtime identity and implementation identity are excluded

constructSeparation.structuralForcingMeaning: bounded reply-narrowing structure only; not game-theoretic or tactical forcing

SFCDF-C1-UNIT-WIDTH-OCCUPANCY-FRACTION.denominator: sum replyWidthHistogram[d][w] for d=0..5 and integer reply width w>0
SFCDF-C1-UNIT-WIDTH-OCCUPANCY-FRACTION.interpretation: share of depth-labelled nonterminal unique RAW-state presences with exactly one legal reply

SFCDF-C2-WIDTH-COMPRESSION-FRACTION.numerator: sum widthCompressionCount[d] for parent depths d=0..4
SFCDF-C2-WIDTH-COMPRESSION-FRACTION.denominator: sum(widthCompressionCount + widthExpansionCount + widthStableCount) for parent depths d=0..4
SFCDF-C2-WIDTH-COMPRESSION-FRACTION.branchExtinction: reported separately; terminal transitions remain classified by the frozen F5 width comparison
SFCDF-C2-WIDTH-COMPRESSION-FRACTION.interpretation: fraction of bounded depth-labelled transitions whose child reply width is lower than the parent reply width

SFCDF-C3-LONGEST-UNIT-WIDTH-RUN.value: maximum length among F5 narrowPathGeometry maximal unit-width records
SFCDF-C3-LONGEST-UNIT-WIDTH-RUN.rightCensoring: retained in contextual raw records; maximum numeric length is still reported
SFCDF-C3-LONGEST-UNIT-WIDTH-RUN.arithmetic: exact integer represented as rational denominator 1
SFCDF-C3-LONGEST-UNIT-WIDTH-RUN.interpretation: longest observed structural one-reply corridor within relative depth 5

SFCDF-C4-RECONVERGENT-STATE-OCCUPANCY-FR.numerator: sum reconvergentRawStateCount[d] for child depths d=1..5
SFCDF-C4-RECONVERGENT-STATE-OCCUPANCY-FR.denominator: sum uniqueRawStateCount[d] for child depths d=1..5
SFCDF-C4-RECONVERGENT-STATE-OCCUPANCY-FR.interpretation: share of non-root depth-labelled unique RAW-state presences carrying at least two distinct root-branch labels

SFCDF-C5-ROOT-BRANCH-OVERLAP-FRACTION.numerator: number of unordered root-move pairs with positive F3 descendant RAW-state overlap at any depth 1..5
SFCDF-C5-ROOT-BRANCH-OVERLAP-FRACTION.interpretation: fraction of distinct initial decision branches that reconverge in descendant RAW-state membership

SFCDF-C6-CUMULATIVE-TREE-RAW-RATIO.denominator: global distinct RAW states over depths 0..5
SFCDF-C6-CUMULATIVE-TREE-RAW-RATIO.zeroDenominatorRule: undefined; expected impossible for a valid root
SFCDF-C6-CUMULATIVE-TREE-RAW-RATIO.interpretation: bounded tree-occurrence inflation relative to unique RAW graph size; contextual funnel/compression descriptor, not by itself transposition proof

trajectoryPolicy.mtajiRoot: first nonterminal phase mtaji state at ply >=44
trajectoryPolicy.pairEligibility: both roots must exist and pass all prospective identity/firewall checks; otherwise reject entire source seed
trajectoryPolicy.selection: source seed ascending, first N eligible pairs

g302Handling.freshnessProtection: entire G3-02 Stage 1 and Stage 2 seed namespaces forbidden

g303Handling.identityOnlyMaterialization: canonical identities may be materialized only into identity-only exclusion manifest before Stage 1

pairedComparison.comparison: BigInt cross multiplication with zero tolerance

stage1Promotion.promotion: coverage + nonzero + dominant-direction gates all pass

stage2FormalValidation.test: exact two-sided sign test on nonzero paired differences
stage2FormalValidation.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise alpha 1/20 across frozen promoted set
stage2FormalValidation.directionGate: observed dominant direction must equal frozen Stage 1 direction
stage2FormalValidation.candidateConfirmation: coverage + nonzero + direction + sequential Holm gate all pass

estimability.undefinedCandidatePairs: candidate-specific coverage gate; does not replace roots

technicalFailureRules.prototypeSensitiveObjectEqualityFailureA: not a scientific gate; canonical content equality governs

executionIntegrity.scientificTrigger: dedicated path-filtered one-shot trigger after separate Stage authorization
executionIntegrity.concurrency: single Stage-specific concurrency group; no automatic rerun
executionIntegrity.remoteAdvancement: fail closed unless every post-authorization path is prospectively allowlisted control-plane metadata
executionIntegrity.canonicalArtifactDurability: upload canonical result artifact before repository mirror
executionIntegrity.scientificResultMirror: repository mirror is secondary to durable Actions artifact

formalDecisionRules.stage0Pass: all synthetic semantic, canonical-equality, implementation-independence and technical materialization gates pass
formalDecisionRules.stage1TechnicalInvalid: any technicalFailureRules trigger after fresh access
formalDecisionRules.stage1NonEstimable: no technical mismatch and estimability gate fails
formalDecisionRules.stage1NoPromotedCandidate: global integrity/estimability pass and promoted set empty; close without Stage 2
formalDecisionRules.stage2Authorization: Stage 1 integrity/estimability pass and nonempty frozen promoted set plus separate authorization
formalDecisionRules.stage2TechnicalInvalid: any technicalFailureRules trigger during formal execution
formalDecisionRules.stage2NonEstimable: no technical mismatch and formal estimability gate fails

afterFreshAccessProhibited: same-seed rerun to repair a frozen implementation defect

interpretationBoundary: structural forcing is not optimal-play forcing
structural forcing is not tactical inevitability
reply narrowing is not search stability
reconvergence is not low human difficulty
none of the endpoints imply position value, win probability, causal rule effect, or game-theoretic forcing
